_doc: Constructed fist, 80 px, ROUND 2 variant r3 (author_hands.py template='r3'). Critique round 2: 'at 80 use a 4-5 px fist with one highlight pixel and one knuckle-shadow pixel so the hand survives'. A 3 x 3 skin interior inside an OL ring (5 x 5): the thumb (t, S1) is the only highlight, the knuckle (l, S4) the only dark pixel inside, the rest S2 back / S3 palm side; the wrist (w, S3) one cell out. Same frame and labels as fist_144_r3.json; 'codes' fixes the tones.
